item.title: SameBoy v1.0.4
item.description:
SameBoy 1.0.4 | sameboy_ios_v1.0.4
This version is backwards compatible with save states from SameBoy 0.14.3 and newer, as well as save states from any BESS compliant emulator
## New/Improved Features * The libretro core now supports API extensions to retrieve additional metadata and create more portable battery save files * The iOS frontend has been updated with improved iOS 27 support * iPhone Duo support was added to the iOS frontend * The CRT scaling filter has been updated with an improved look * A new Pixelated/Sharp Bilinear scaling filter * This new filter is now the default filter in the Cocoa and SDL frontends * VFS support was added to the libretro core * Logging support was added to the libretro core * The libretro core will now render audio directly in the frontend's audio sample rate, if supported * Recording audio to a VGM log file is now possible in the Cocoa and SDL frontends * Minor UI improvements in the Cocoa frontend
## Accuracy Improvements/Fixes * Workboy emulation now correctly reports the current weekday * Fixed a bug that made certain small ROM files be incorrectly detected as MMM01 cartridges * More accurate emulation of SGB command processing
## Bug Fixes * Fixed a bug where periodic battery saves were performed from the wrong thread in the Cocoa frontend, causing debug builds to crash * Fixed controller hotkeys not working on newer macOS versions in the Cocoa frontend * Fixed a bug that prevented mapping Load State commands to a controller hotkey in the Cocoa frontend * The libretro core no longer reports an RTC memory region when emulating cartridges without an RTC * Fixed a bug that could trigger memory corruptions on x86-64 platforms when loading malformed save states * Improved sanitization of the Game Boy Printer save state data * Fixed an incorrectly label “Rumble strength” label in the Cocoa frontend * File dialogs on Windows now switch Full Screen mode off before they appear, working around bugs in Windows' windowing system * Fixed a bug that made the Joycon autopair button not work in the Cocoa frontend * Fixed a bug that made breakpoints created by the `GB_debugger_execute_command` API would not trigger under some conditions when using SameBoy as a library
## Misc Internal Changes * The build system no longer prints ignored errors when building SameBoy without RGBDS installed if prebuilt boot ROMs are used * `ibtool` no longer silently fails when building the Cocoa or iOS frontends * The logging API now has attribute flags that mark if a log line is an error or a warning caused by the previous API call

item.title: Jellify v1.2.11
item.description:
Jellify 1.2.11 | Jellify-1.2.11
Welcome to Jellify 1.2.11
We are bringing you a highly stable update focused on fixing key areas related to playback and library integration. This release smooths out common glitches, ensuring your music streams and playlists look perfect no matter what device or Jellyfin version you are using.
* **Playlist Visibility Fixed:** We corrected an issue that caused playlists to fail to display correctly when using certain versions of Jellyfin (specifically version 12). Your comprehensive music library should now be fully accessible and visible across your connected accounts. * **Improved Shuffle Playback:** We addressed a regression in the music shuffling system. Enjoy continuous, uninterrupted listening experiences, knowing that your random playlist order is always stable and reliable. * **Enhanced Stability and Compatibility:** This update includes several deep configuration cleanups and dependency upgrades. These changes improve overall performance and compatibility, making the core streaming experience faster and more robust than ever before.
